journey.name: TL-07 Undoing a completed task brings it back completed
journey.description:
Covers the hardest guarantee in FR-12. A TaskDraft has no isCompleted field, so the restore cannot carry the flag in the create payload - RestoreTaskUseCase creates the task and then makes a second setCompleted call (WALKTHROUGH.md section 5). If that second call is dropped, a completed task quietly comes back unfinished and the user has to notice on their own.
"Book dentist" is the only seed row that starts completed.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that the "Book dentist" row has a checked checkbox
Tap the element with the content description "Delete task" on the "Book dentist" row
Verify that a message reading "Task deleted" is on screen
Tap the "Undo" action on that message
Verify that "Book dentist" is on screen again
Verify that the restored "Book dentist" row has a checked checkbox
Verify that the restored "Book dentist" title is struck through
Verify that the restored "Book dentist" row still has an element with the content description "Low"
